correction: A suite-switch run must change only its own links: the systemd-sysext refresh changes every pending state of the host, so before it refreshes it checks the host's other pending changes (pendingActivationLinks: activations, deactivations and unreadable states) and, when one exists, keeps its links, skips the refresh and reports RefreshSkipped instead of activating an update that ADR-0016 holds for the next boot or unmerging a sysext that is merged but not linked. Guard: TestUpdateFeatures_SuiteSwitchKeepsOtherActivationsForNextBoot.
